records.text: North Works is a week in with no project yet, worth a nudge at this point

records.subject: Re: How's the first week going?
records.body:
Hi Chidi,

Thanks for checking in -- things are going well so far, still getting used to the layout but no complaints.

Lin

records.subject: How's the first week going?
records.body:
Hi Lin,

Wanted to check in on North Works' setup. If you haven't gotten to inviting the rest of the team yet, no rush -- just let me know if anything's in the way.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.subject: Get your team moving with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Lin,

A reminder that your Wrenfield workspace is ready whenever you are -- creating one real project is the easiest way to see what it's for.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Lin,

Welcome! Wrenfield works best once there's a real project in it, so that's the one thing I'd suggest doing first. Inviting your team comes next -- tasks are a lot more useful once more than one person is on them.

Reply any time.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.text: New signup alert -- *North Works* just created a workspace on starter.

decisions.rationale: Lin replied warmly and is exploring with "no complaints" [email:9f33a38a], and one invite was sent, showing some momentum. But 6 days in, no first project despite three nudges [email:f92e2d37, email:5cba642f, email:463050e5], and starter plan with low urgency; 8 days left makes unaided activation possible but under even odds.

draft.subject: Re: How's the first week going?
draft.body:
Hi Lin,

Glad to hear it's going well and that the layout's starting to click — thanks for the reply.

One thing worth knowing as you find your footing: projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, so getting one real project in place is what makes the rest make sense. I saw an invite has gone out too, which is a good next step.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through setting up that first project with you and answer anything about the layout.

Best,
Chidi
